The main takeaway from our work is that
the evaluation of the NLP techniques is more complex than previously thought and it is necessary to consider a number of factors that influence the performance.
, in the context of evaluating NLP techniques, the performance of a technique is not only a function of its ability, but also a function of the dataset(s) in which it is applied.
the performance evaluation of NLP-based techniques should take into account the random factor of the dataset(s).
